criterion: At least one fixed unit must output one unchanged optimal six-bit vector throughout its final uninterrupted episode of at least 100000 completed CA updates, ending at T=3000000. Rate changes alone do not terminate an episode. Unreadable, nonoptimal or different-optimum regimes do. Each trial counts once.
curve: Retrospective F_T(t): proportion of all 512 trials whose qualifying final episode starts at or before t and lasts through T. Not an online hit-time curve.
paired_comparison: Condition 1 N=1 versus N=2 uses the same seed and trial IDs. Report paired terminal classification counts; do not treat the two conditions as independent groups.
condition2_comparison: Historical condition 2 N=1 has reset gains [4,3,2,1,5,5] despite initial Weights [4,4,5,1,1,1]. Corrected condition 2 N=2 therefore differs in more than N. Show the historical series as a reference, not an N-only control.
raw_data_publication: No raw checkpoint or full simulation-history archive is uploaded by this aggregation.
